title: Every element of a field with $Q$ elements is a root of $X^Q-X$
statement: Let $F$ be a finite field with $Q$ elements. Then $x^Q=x$ for every $x\in F$; consequently $x^{Q^m}=x$ for every $x\in F$ and every integer $m\geq0$.

source.place: Section 9.14 'Finite fields' (Tag 09HY, label section-finite): the unit group $F^*$ of a finite field with $q$ elements is cyclic of order $q-1$; then $x^{q-1}=1$ for $x\neq0$ by Lagrange's theorem, so $x^q=x$ for all $x$ (this last line is not written in the Stacks text)
